ops.title: CI: PR #3 first run, lint and lint-linux red, test-linux expected red
ops.premise: The first exact-head CI run on PR #3 (head a92416aa53d8032e0961495e8a13f13351ac788e, the Linux port) has golangci-lint failing on both the macOS lint job and the new lint-linux job, and test-linux is expected to fail on untagged test fixtures written against the Darwin registry and store shape (no meta table, arc endpoints, cookie.Apply into an empty store refused on Linux). The lint findings are either pre-existing debt surfaced by the new Linux leg or introduced by the port.
